cli.intro: open-cam - OpenCAM 2.5-axis toolpath and G-code generator (millimetres)

cmd.capabilities: print the operation and I/O disclosure matrix
cmd.import: import geometry from another file format
cmd.import-dxf: import an ASCII DXF drawing as engrave operations
cmd.tool-list: list every tool with the operations that use it
cmd.tool-export: write the tool table as a portable library file
cmd.tool-import: merge a portable tool library into the document
cmd.operation-list: list every operation with its fields and estimated motion time
cmd.operation-update: change selected fields of one operation
cmd.operation-duplicate: copy an operation directly after itself
cmd.operation-reorder: move an operation to a new 0-based position
cmd.feeds: recommend spindle and feed rates for a material and tool diameter
cmd.sequence: plan or apply a tool-grouped operation order
cmd.export: export G-code, JSON, CSV, Markdown, an SVG drawing or a PDF drawing

opt.depth: cut depth or stock depth in millimetres
opt.new-id: id of a duplicated operation (defaults to the next free op-N)
opt.to: final 0-based position of the operation (0 … operation count − 1)
opt.name: display name (defaults to the id)
opt.plunge: plunge feed in mm/min (default a third of the feed)
opt.kind: operation kind: face, contour, pocket, drill or engrave
opt.tool: id of the tool the operation uses
opt.stepdown: stepdown per pass in millimetres (default the full depth)
opt.shape: pocket or contour shape: rect or circle (circle uses --width as the diameter and needs --height equal to --width)
opt.arcs: circular ring interpolation: linear (72 chords) or arc (counter-clockwise G3 half arcs)
opt.material: material name: aluminium, brass, steel, stainless, plastic or wood
opt.peck: peck depth for drilling in millimetres
opt.dwell: dwell at the hole bottom in seconds
opt.island: island as `x,y,w,h` or `circle,x,y,diameter`; repeat for several islands
opt.closed: treat the engrave or contour path as a closed loop
opt.finish: mark the operation as a finishing pass
opt.program-number: program number emitted as `O<n>` after the leading `%`
opt.line-numbers: prefix every program line with a sequential `N` word
opt.coolant: coolant mode: off, flood (`M8`) or mist (`M7`)
opt.apply: reorder and save the document instead of only printing the plan
opt.out: write the result to this path (SVG and PDF drawings print to stdout when omitted)
opt.from: file to import (a tool library or an ASCII DXF drawing)
opt.tolerance: maximum chord sagitta when flattening DXF arcs and circles, in millimetres (default 0.05)
opt.format: export format: gcode, json, csv, md, svg or pdf

warn.droppedCharacters: the drawing replaced {count} non-ASCII character(s) with `?`

error.unknownArcMode: unknown arc mode `{value}`; only linear or arc is supported
error.unknownFormat: unknown export format `{format}`; only gcode, json, csv, md, svg, pdf or dxf is supported
